cited.quote: guidelines for production and sales of Deemed export goods with 20% rebate subsidy
measures to increase the performance of Handloom Weavers’ Co-operative Societies

rationale: C5 is GO 133 (07.12.2020) issuing guidelines and a rebate subsidy for handloom weavers' co-operative societies' export production and sales; C3 describes government measures to raise society performance. A dedicated order on societies, though narrow in scope.

cited.quote: Handloom Support Programme to support innovation and product diversiEication in the handloom sector

rationale: C4 is the GO (2019-03-04) implementing the New Integrated Textile Policy, which sets up a Handloom Support Programme with an allocation of Rs.40 crore for the co-operative handloom sector. It is a dedicated support measure, though its link to profitability is indirect.

cited.quote: Variety menu is being implemented with effect from 15.8.2014

rationale: C1 and C3 show the variety meal menu running since 2014, before the government took office. No extract shows a new official step after 2016-05-23 introducing new food varieties.

cited.quote: helps to identify and curb illegal mining and quarrying activities in the State

rationale: C4 describes a satellite surveillance system against illegal quarrying but nothing on concluding cases or recovering losses. C3/C5 lapse a lease for non-operation, which is a different matter. Related activity only.

cited.quote: Steps have been taken to establish 45 KLPD Distillery-cum-Ethanol plant at Cheyyar Coop. Sugar Mills.

rationale: C2 reports preparatory steps for new distillery-cum-ethanol plants at co-operative sugar mills: environmental clearance obtained, loan being sought, tender yet to be called. No operational plant or GO is shown.

cited.quote: Government have issued orders for purchase of 2000 new buses for the year 2019-2020 to all State Transport Undertakings
this Government has introduced 1,525 new routes across the State in the past 6 years

rationale: C4 shows the GO of 21.10.2019 ordering purchase of 2000 new buses for all STUs; C3 reports new routes introduced by this Government. Earlier purchases are only reported by year in policy notes, so the dated GO is used.

cited.quote: deposited into a separate bank account of Tamil Nadu Waqf Board on 09.01.2018
a corpus fund of Rs.3 crore has been created

rationale: C1 and C3 report a Rs.3 crore corpus fund for repair and renovation of mosques, held in a separate bank account of the Waqf Board, deposited on 09.01.2018. C3 shows creation earlier, but only C1 gives a written date.

cited.quote: Redressal Committees at the Taluk/ Divisional/ District level for disposing of petitions

rationale: C1 mentions encroachment redressal committees from 2014, before this government. C2 and C3 are planning and land-use conversion rules, C4 service tax on leases. None is a guideline against land grabbing or property usurpation.
The extracts cover the intellectual property enforcement cell (video piracy), cyber crime, IPS transfers and police medals. None concerns special police cells for property grab complaints.

cited.quote: sanction a sum of Rs.58,000/- (Rupees fifty eight thousand only) for conducting training to Organic farmers

rationale: C1 is a GO dated 2017-02-07 sanctioning funds to train registered organic farmers and operators on organic standards. It is a dedicated organic-farming measure, though small in scale.

cited.quote: An assistance of Rs.20,000 per acre/farmer is provided over a period of three years from seed to harvest

rationale: C4 is a GO of 2018-01-22 on the Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana organic farming scheme giving Rs.20,000 per acre assistance. The scheme began in 2015-16, before this government, so this GO is the first dated official measure in the extracts.
The extracts cover Tamil digitisation, machine translation tools and translation of English books into Tamil. None concerns translating ancient Tamil books into other languages.

cited.quote: Tamil Nadu had emphasised that the Inter Linking of Rivers Project should be taken up immediately
Hon’ble Chief Minister wrote to Hon’ble Minister for Jal Shakti on 03.06.2019 and 23.08.2019

rationale: C3 lists a Special Committee meeting on 26.07.2016, after the government took office, where the state pressed for immediate river linking. C2 shows later letters by the Chief Minister to the Union Minister and Prime Minister. Formal urging done.

cited.quote: not much headway has been made in the matter of inter-linking of rivers
no steps were taken by the Government of India to implement the inter linking of rivers project

rationale: C1 and C4 show the state repeatedly pressing the Union government, while the Union took no steps to implement river linking. The state acted but delivery rests with the Union. Extracts address only the national interlinking project.

cited.quote: To facilitate the entrepreneurs to establish Mini Textile Parks in the State in a minimum extent of 2 acres

rationale: C4 is the 2019 GO adopting a textile policy with subsidy for Mini Textile Parks and state grants for parks. It is an enabling order, and no new park is shown established. The eight parks in C1 were sanctioned in 2006-2011.

cited.quote: Perarignar Anna Handloom Silk Park at Kilkathirpur, Kancheepuram District

rationale: C1 and C2 list a silk park sanctioned in 2010, before this government, with construction pending. No extract shows a new silk textile park step after 2016-05-23.

cited.quote: Government have accorded sanction for a sum of Rs.750 Crore for the implementation of Tamil Nadu
THAI II Scheme has been implemented in all the Village Panchayats with an annual allocation of

rationale: C2 refers to the GO of 25.10.2016 sanctioning Rs.750 crore for THAI-II (2016-17); C3 reports implementation in all Village Panchayats. The scheme was continued at its earlier annual allocation.

cited.quote: scholarships have been awarded for Rs. 56.43 Crores to the 309149 Minority students studying 1st to 10th Std
scholarships have been awarded for Rs.6,674.51 lakh to 3,24,556 Minority students studying from 1st to 10th Std

rationale: C1, C2 and C3 show minority pre-matric, post-matric, merit-cum-means and Maulana Azad scholarships continuing through 2016-17 to 2019-20 with growing numbers. No GO is cited, so only the year is given.
